requirements.rule: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.
requirements.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: Art. 102 (2024 CCNL, PDF p. 117): the once-only loyalty award is paid in the month 25 cumulative years of cooperative-banking movement service are reached, only at QD3/QD4, at 90.66% of the enumerated monthly salary items. The caller must state movement service in Employment.seniority, including earlier employers and breaks. The monthly run-chain may include items outside the enumerated base (salary, seniority increment, restructuring amount per increment, increment/table difference allowances, deputy-director and branch-manager allowances); the engine cannot restrict the award base to those items.
requirements.remediation: Restrict the award base to the Art. 102 enumerated salary items; supply a movement-specific credited seniority fact rather than general increment seniority when these differ.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2), which also excludes its cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day. A national CCNL rule that sets other hours to a day of leave prevails (art. 32 c. 1-bis): the run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL (work_rules.parental_hourly) or the rule sets its own hours, which the engine does not apply yet; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SCATTI: at most 8 for the 1st and 2nd level of the quadri direttivi and for the aree professionali, 7 for the 3rd and 4th level of the quadri (Art. 101, Art. 113); 12 (9 for the 3rd and 4th level of the quadri) for the staff in service on 31 December 1997 (seniority_increments.in_service_cohort), read from the stated employment period (the caller states a period covering 31 December 1997 only for a worker in service on that day). Not modelled: the 'ulteriore aumento periodico' after the 12th scatto (Allegato A §5: 8.68 for the quadri and the 3a area, 7.35, 6.19 and 6.69 for the 2a and 1a), reached at the earliest in mid-2033 by a worker hired in 1997 (48 months, a 30-month scatto in progress in 2001, then every 36); the 30-month scatto in progress at the change of cadence of 2001.
requirements.remediation: Pay the further increase of Allegato A §5 from the 12th scatto of the 1997 cohort.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
